title: PHE-SICH-CT-IDS: A Benchmark CT Image Dataset for Evaluation Semantic Segmentation, Object Detection and Radiomic Feature Extraction of Perihematomal Edema in Spontaneous Intracerebral Hemorrhage
reasoning: The paper focuses on establishing and evaluating a medical imaging dataset for diagnostic purposes in spontaneous intracerebral hemorrhage. It does not contain any component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics.
